Bill.BriefDescription: Providing assistance to landowners complying with regulations associated with protection of the Mazama pocket gopher.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing assistance to landowners complyingwith regulations associated with protection of the Mazama pocketgopher; adding a new section to chapter 77.12 RCW; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Upon request, the department shall conduct biological surveys,provide assistance with habitat or other management plans, and providerelevant information and other technical assistance to a person seekingsuch assistance in order to comply with the requirements of localcritical area ordinances under RCW 36.70A.060(2) that relate to theprotection of the Mazama pocket gopher (Thomomys mazama) or itshabitat. (2) Cities and counties may only apply those provisions of criticalarea ordinances under RCW 36.70A.060(2) to protect the Mazama pocketgopher where the department provides assistance upon request asprovided under subsection (1) of this section.
The department of fish and wildlife shallprovide assistance as provided in section 1 of this act within existingresources.
